notes.title: Patch Notes for June 17, 2024
notes.notes:
- Added support for different game versions when hosting a multiplayer server
- Fixed bug with in-game shop items for Windows 64-bit version

notes.title: Update 1.6.9
notes.notes:
Update 1.6.9 introduces the Operation Editor, an in-game tool that lets you create your own missions!

Operation Editor
Create your own missions with the new Operation Editor!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40197790/670a2f2b259a461bbe87bfa75eae33a8666f0b18.png 

The editor is integrated with Steam Workshop, allowing you to share your own missions or browse community missions.

Check out the guide here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3214649587

Other Notes
- Motion Sensors and Jammers can now be thrown
- Added Napalm attachment for Shotguns
- Added new hero: Agent 1237
- New character animations for NPCs
- UI and music updates
- Performance optimizations

Discord
Remember to join the official Discord server, now with a dedicated Operation Editor channel!

notes.title: Update 1.6.7
notes.notes:
Update 1.6.7 brings a lot of new content to Deadswitch 3, including 2 new maps!

Downturn Extended
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40197790/d16c6a1ab99744e743a50793ea972e27fc87dc33.png
Tactical map expanded from the original Downturn!

Battleship
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40197790/110ac2a026f15d248aa1ec66714cdb062aa122ed.png
Massive battleship with multiple vertical levels!

Promo Codes
Promo codes are now supported in Deadswitch 3. 
Go to Ranked > Profile > Redeem Code to redeem a promo code.

Other Notes

 New challenges
 Slightly increased sprint and crouch movement speed
 Increased default number of bots from 5 to 7 (local play)
 Reduced lobby timers from 30 to 15 seconds (multiplayer)
 Chat text is now also displayed above each player (multiplayer)
 Performance optimizations
 Lots of UI updates
 Bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes for November 2, 2021
notes.notes:
General

 Optimized ragdoll physics
 Added new effects
 Increased RC-XD speed, damage, and explosive radius


Operations

 Novice Operations now award 2,500 XP
 Moderate Operations now award 10,000 XP
 Veteran Operations now award 25,000 XP


Survival

 Shard kill threshold reduced to 500 for Zombie and Terrorist
 Shard kill threshold reduced to 350 for Chaos and Stakeout


Weapons

 G17: Damage increased from 25 to 26
 Five-seveN: Damage increased from 26 to 28
 P320: Recoil reduced from 1.5 to 1.3
 Honey Badger: Headshot multiplier reduced from 1.8 to 1.7
 PAR4-C: Headshot multiplier reduced from 1.8 to 1.7
 SKS: Recoil reduced from 1.2 to 1
 Sawed-Off: Damage increased from 52 to 55
 L115A3: Damage increased from 240 to 250, headshot multiplier increased from 1.5 to 1.6
 Dragunov: Accuracy reduced from 1 to 1.5
